영등포구의회Yeongdeungpo-gu Council · p.4

영등포구의회, 제271회 제1차 정례회 개회YDP Council Opens the 271st 1st Regular Session

영등포구의회(의장 김길자)는 9월 4일 오전 11시 본회의를 열고 21일까지 18일간의 일정으로 제271회 제1차 정례회를 개회했다. 김길자 의장은 개회사에서 "지난여름 폭염과 집중호우 속에서도 구민 안전을 위해 현장에서 애써주신 공무원과 지역사회 구성원들께 감사드린다"며, "어르신과 장애인 등 재난 취약계층이 피해를 입지 않도록 세심한 보호와 선제적 대응을 최우선 과제로 추진해야 한다"고 강조했다.

이어 "2025회계연도 결산과 2026년도 제1회 추가경정예산안, 주요 조례안 등을 면밀히 심사해 민생 안정을 도모하겠다"며, "현장에서 구민의 목소리에 귀 기울여 실질적인 변화를 이끄는 '신뢰받는 의회, 일하는 의회'를 만들어가겠다"고 말했다. 한편, 이번 정례회에서는 조례안 등 심사, 주요 업무보고, 2025회계연도 결산 및 예비비 지출 승인, 2026년도 제1회 추가경정예산안 등 심사, 구정질문 등이 진행되었으며, 상정된 안건은 조례안 11건, 규칙안 1건, 의견청취 1건, 승인안 1건, 결산안 1건, 예산안 1건, 기타안 1건 등 총 17건이다.

5분 자유발언

이규선 의원(영등포동, 당산2동)
"의회와 집행기관 간 협력을 통한 구민 중심 행정의 필요성"
임헌호 의원(당산1동, 양평1·2동)
"어르신 이동권 보장을 위한 경로당 이용 환경 개선 촉구"
최인순 의원(도림동, 문래동)
"구청장의 신청사 건립 재검토 발언에 대한 의견 표명"
유승용 의원(신길6동, 대림1·2·3동)
"대림2동 공공복합청사 대체 부지 검토 및 조속한 이전 촉구"
이성수 의원(신길6동, 대림1·2·3동)
"영등포구 주요 현안에 대한 실효성 있는 대응 방안 수립 촉구"

예산결산특별위원회 구성

영등포구의회는 9월 4일 열린 제271회 제1차 정례회 제1차 본회의에서 예산결산특별위원회를 구성했다. 예산결산특별위원회 위원으로는 이성수(위원장), 김태현(부위원장), 박미영, 박제욱, 서천열, 이규선, 임헌호, 하혜진, 황진환 의원이 선임되었으며, 영등포구청장이 제출한 2026년도 제1회 추가경정예산안을 17일과 18일 양일간 종합심사를 실시했다.

영등포구의회, 인권교육 실시

영등포구의회(의장 김길자)는 9월 4일 오후 2시 다목적회의실에서 구의원과 의회사무국 직원을 대상으로 인권 교육을 실시했다. 이번 교육은 급변하는 디지털 환경 속에서 올바른 인권 가치를 확립하고 성숙한 의정 활동의 기반을 다지기 위해 마련됐다. 김길자 의장은 "제10대 의회 개원 후 첫 회기의 시작과 동시에 인권교육을 실시하게 되어 매우 뜻깊게 생각한다"며, "이번 교육이 디지털 시대의 인권 가치에 대한 올바른 기준을 확립하고, 나아가 구민을 위한 의정활동 속에서도 이를 적극적으로 실천하는 계기가 되길 바란다"고 덧붙였다. 한편, 강사로 초빙된 리프 노동법률사무소 오지슬 대표는 '디지털 전환, 인공지능(AI)과 인권'을 주제로 강의를 진행하였으며, 고령층과 장애인 등 취약계층의 디지털 격차 문제부터 딥페이크 성범죄, AI 알고리즘 편향성, 개인정보 보호 이슈까지 공공부문에서 주목해야 할 주요 인권 과제를 다뤘다.

The Yeongdeungpo-gu Council (Speaker Kim Gil-ja) opened the 271st 1st Regular Session on an 18-day schedule through the 21st, with a plenary session held at 11:00 a.m. on September 4. In her opening address, Speaker Kim said, "I thank the public officials and community members who worked hard on the ground for residents' safety through last summer's heat wave and heavy rain," and stressed that "careful protection and proactive response so that disaster-vulnerable groups such as the elderly and people with disabilities are not harmed must be pursued as a top priority."

She added that the council "will closely examine the FY2025 settlement, the FY2026 1st supplementary budget bill, and major ordinances to help stabilize residents' livelihoods," and that it would "build a 'trusted, working council' that listens to residents on the ground and drives real change." This session covered review of ordinance bills, key work reports, approval of the FY2025 settlement and reserve-fund spending, review of the FY2026 1st supplementary budget bill, and questions to the administration. A total of 17 agenda items were tabled: 11 ordinance bills, 1 rule bill, 1 opinion hearing, 1 approval bill, 1 settlement bill, 1 budget bill and 1 other bill.

5-Minute Free Speeches

Rep. Lee Gyu-seon (Yeongdeungpo-dong, Dangsan 2-dong)
"The need for resident-centered administration through council–executive cooperation"
Rep. Lim Heon-ho (Dangsan 1-dong, Yangpyeong 1·2-dong)
"A call to improve senior centers' facilities to secure elders' mobility rights"
Rep. Choi In-sun (Dorim-dong, Munrae-dong)
"A statement on the mayor's remark reconsidering the new office building project"
Rep. Yu Seung-yong (Singil 6-dong, Daerim 1·2·3-dong)
"A call to review alternative sites for the Daerim 2-dong public complex and expedite relocation"
Rep. Lee Seong-su (Singil 6-dong, Daerim 1·2·3-dong)
"A call to establish effective response plans for YDP's key issues"

Budget & Settlement Special Committee Formed

At the 1st plenary session of the 271st 1st Regular Session on September 4, the YDP Council formed its Budget & Settlement Special Committee. Members appointed were Lee Seong-su (Chair), Kim Tae-hyun (Vice Chair), Park Mi-yeong, Park Je-uk, Seo Cheon-yeol, Lee Gyu-seon, Lim Heon-ho, Ha Hye-jin, and Hwang Jin-hwan, and the committee held a comprehensive review of the FY2026 1st supplementary budget bill submitted by the YDP mayor over two days, the 17th and 18th.

Chair
Rep. Lee Seong-su
Vice Chair
Rep. Kim Tae-hyun

YDP Council Holds Human Rights Training

The YDP Council (Speaker Kim Gil-ja) held human rights training for council members and secretariat staff at 2:00 p.m. on September 4 in the multipurpose meeting room. The training was arranged to establish sound human-rights values amid rapid digital change and to lay a foundation for mature legislative work. Speaker Kim said, "I find it very meaningful that we are holding human rights training right at the start of the 10th Council's first session," adding that she hoped "this training will establish the right standards on human-rights values in the digital era, and further become an occasion to actively practice them in legislative work for residents." Lecturer Oh Ji-seul, head of Leaf Labor Law Office, spoke on 'Digital Transformation, AI, and Human Rights,' covering key public-sector human-rights issues from the digital divide among vulnerable groups such as the elderly and people with disabilities, to deepfake sex crimes, AI algorithmic bias, and personal-data protection.

행복한 우리 동네 이야기

영등포동

추석맞이 어르신과 함께 전통시장 장보기

한국마사회 영등포지사(지사장 김영립)는 추석을 앞두고 지역 내 저소득 어르신을 위해 온누리상품권 1천만 원을 후원했다. 영등포동 지역사회보장협의체(위원장 김진규)는 후원받은 상품권으로 9월 4일 영등포전통시장에서 어르신들과 함께 추석맞이 장보기 행사를 진행했다. 어르신들은 전통시장을 둘러보며 명절에 필요한 식재료와 생필품을 직접 구입하고 따뜻한 명절을 준비했다. 김진규 위원장은 "앞으로도 취약계층을 세심히 살피고 지역사회와 함께 나눔과 상생을 위한 활동을 이어가겠다"고 전했다.

문래동

시립문래청소년센터 후원품 전달

8월 20일 문래동새마을금고 ESG홍보위원회와 ㈜한바다는 지역 청소년을 위해 뜻을 모아 시립문래청소년센터 청소년 카페에 라면과 김치를 전달했다. 이번 후원을 계기로 문래동새마을금고는 라면을, ㈜한바다는 김치 10kg을 매월 정기적으로 후원하며 청소년들의 건강한 성장을 지속적으로 지원하기로 했다. 전달된 후원품은 청소년 카페를 이용하는 청소년들을 위해 사용될 예정이다. 최종연 문래동장은 "앞으로도 지역 내 기업·단체와 협력해 청소년을 위한 나눔과 지원을 확대해 나가겠다"고 전했다.

청년연합체육대회, 영등포 종합 우승!

생활권을 공유하는 영등포·광명·관악·금천 청년들이 함께하는 청년연합체육대회가 9월 12일 광명시민체육관에서 열렸습니다. 4개 지역 청년 약 500명이 박 터뜨리기, 바람잡는 특공대, OX퀴즈 등 다양한 종목에서 선의의 경쟁을 펼친 가운데, 영등포 대표팀이 총 3,620점으로 종합 우승을 차지했습니다.

내년에는 영등포에서 만나요! 청년연합체육대회는 우승 지역의 이름을 다음 해 대회명에 붙여 이어갑니다. 올해 영등포가 종합 우승을 차지하면서 내년 대회는 「2027 Youth Championship in 영등포」로 열립니다.

Happy Stories from Our Neighborhood

Yeongdeungpo-dong

Shopping the Traditional Market with Seniors for Chuseok

The Korea Racing Authority's Yeongdeungpo branch (Director Kim Yeong-rip) donated KRW 10 million in Onnuri gift certificates for low-income seniors ahead of Chuseok. The Yeongdeungpo-dong Community Welfare Council (Chair Kim Jin-gyu) used the certificates to hold a Chuseok shopping event with seniors at Yeongdeungpo Traditional Market on September 4. Seniors browsed the market and bought holiday ingredients and daily necessities themselves to prepare for a warm holiday. Chair Kim said, "We will keep closely looking after vulnerable residents and continue sharing and mutual-growth activities with the community."

Munrae-dong

Donations Delivered to Munrae Youth Center

On August 20, Munrae-dong Saemaul Geumgo's ESG committee and Hanbada Co., Ltd. joined forces for local youth, delivering ramen and kimchi to the youth café at the Municipal Munrae Youth Center. Following this donation, Saemaul Geumgo will regularly donate ramen and Hanbada 10kg of kimchi each month to keep supporting youth's healthy growth. The donated goods will be used for youth who use the café. Munrae-dong Chief Choi Jong-yeon said, "We will keep working with local businesses and groups to expand sharing and support for youth."

Youth Joint Athletic Meet — Yeongdeungpo Wins Overall!

The Youth Joint Athletic Meet, bringing together youth from neighboring Yeongdeungpo, Gwangmyeong, Gwanak and Geumcheon, was held on September 12 at the Gwangmyeong Citizens' Gymnasium. About 500 youth from the four areas competed in friendly events such as piñata bursting, balloon-catching relay and OX quiz, and Team Yeongdeungpo took the overall title with 3,620 points.

See you in Yeongdeungpo next year! The event carries the winning region's name into next year's title — since Yeongdeungpo won overall this year, next year's meet will be held as the '2027 Youth Championship in Yeongdeungpo.'

정비사업의 든든한 해결사 「신속추진지원단」

영등포구가 정비사업의 원활한 추진을 돕기 위해 108명의 현장·전문지원매니저로 구성된 「신속추진지원단」을 구성합니다. 9월 23일 위촉식을 시작으로 사업 현장을 살피고, 추진 과정에서 발생하는 다양한 어려움의 해결을 지원할 계획입니다.

이달의 헌법

헌법 제35조 제3항
"국가는 주택개발정책등을 통하여 모든 국민이 쾌적한 주거생활을 할 수 있도록 노력하여야 한다."
Q. 헌법에 왜 '주거생활'을 담았나요?
집은 단순히 머무는 공간이 아니라 안정적인 일상과 인간다운 생활을 위한 중요한 기반이기 때문입니다. 헌법은 주거를 개인의 문제에만 맡기지 않고, 모든 국민이 쾌적한 환경에서 생활할 수 있도록 국가도 함께 노력해야 할 영역으로 보고 있습니다.

영등포가 제안하는 '헌법주택'

영등포구는 헌법이 담고 있는 '쾌적한 주거생활'의 가치를 일상에서 실현하기 위한 새로운 주거 모델로 '헌법주택'을 제안합니다. 공공이 주택을 직접 짓거나 매입해 품질 좋은 주택을 공급하고, 누구나 안정적이고 존엄한 주거생활을 누릴 수 있는 환경을 지향합니다.

  • 공공이 주택을 직접 건설하거나 매입합니다.
  • 쾌적한 주거생활을 위한 고품질의 주택을 공급합니다.
  • 임차뿐 아니라 투자, 단독·공유 소유 등 다양한 방식으로 진행합니다.
  • 다양한 계층이 어우러져 살아가는 공간입니다.
  • 신혼부부, 학령기 자녀 가구, 장애인 등에 우선 공급을 생각합니다.

YDP is renewing aging residential areas, supplying new housing, and building a district that upholds human dignity.

What Is the Urban Public Housing Complex Project?

A project in which the public sector takes part in supplying housing and improving living conditions in station-area, quasi-industrial, and low-rise residential areas that are hard to develop through private methods alone. Public agencies such as LH take part as project operators under the Special Act on Public Housing.

Redevelopment Division, Public Renewal Team, 02-2670-3578, 3806

The 'Rapid Response Support Team' for Renewal Projects

To help renewal projects proceed smoothly, Yeongdeungpo-gu is forming a 'Rapid Response Support Team' of 108 on-site and expert support managers. Starting with an inauguration ceremony on September 23, the team will monitor project sites and help resolve various difficulties that arise during implementation.

Redevelopment Division, Strategic Renewal Team, 02-2670-3535

Who it covers
Renewal zones from the planning (fast-track) stage through groundbreaking
How it works
The responsible division assigns teams to each target zone based on project stage and on-site conditions
Composition
48 on-site support managers, 60 expert support managers (12 conflict mediation, 17 appraisal, 4 construction management, 5 cost verification, 9 urban planning, 10 legal, 3 tax/accounting)

Key Roles

  • On-site support — dedicated teams per zone, field-centered support
  • Expert support — professional review in accounting, tax, law, appraisal, etc.
  • Conflict prevention — monitoring issues and acting before conflicts arise
  • Capacity building — training for residents and renewal-project staff

This Month's Constitution

Constitution Art. 35(3)
"The State shall endeavor, through housing development policy and the like, to ensure that every citizen may enjoy a pleasant housing life."
Q. Why does the Constitution cover 'housing life'?
Because a home is not merely a place to stay, but an important foundation for a stable daily life and human dignity. The Constitution treats housing not as an individual's problem alone, but as an area the State must also work on so that every citizen can live in a pleasant environment.

Yeongdeungpo Proposes 'Constitution Housing'

Yeongdeungpo-gu proposes 'Constitution Housing' as a new housing model to realize the Constitution's value of 'pleasant housing life' in everyday terms. The public sector builds or buys housing directly to supply quality homes, aiming for an environment where everyone can enjoy stable, dignified housing.

  • The public sector directly builds or purchases the housing.
  • Supplies high-quality housing for a pleasant living environment.
  • Offered through various methods — not just rental, but investment, sole/shared ownership, etc.
  • A space where people of diverse backgrounds live together.
  • Priority supply is being considered for newlyweds, households with school-age children, people with disabilities, and more.

Housing Division, Multi-Unit Housing Management Team, 02-2670-3655

Useful Disability Support Information

① Personal Assistance for People with Disabilities
Who: Registered persons 6–64 found eligible by a comprehensive assessment / What: A personal assistant visits the home to help with physical activity, housework, mobility and other daily/social activities / Hours: 60–480 hrs/month by assessment score / How: Visit your dong community center Contact: Disability Welfare Div., Support Team, 02-2670-3917
② Disability Voucher Taxi
Who: Seoul residents 14+ registered with the disability welfare call service or call-taxi who do not use a wheelchair (manual wheelchair OK, power wheelchair not eligible) / Fare: KRW 1,500 up to 5km (extra beyond that) / Uses: 60/month / How: Visit your dong community center (call-taxi members contact the Mobility Support Center, 1588-4388) Contact: Disability Welfare Div., Support Team, 02-2670-3483
③ Wheelchair Repair Cost Support
Who: Registered persons with disabilities in YDP / Items: Power wheelchairs, power scooters, manual wheelchairs / Amount: up to KRW 300,000/yr for basic-livelihood/near-poverty recipients, 50% of repair cost (up to 100,000/yr) for others / How: Visit your dong community center Contact: Disability Welfare Div., Administration Team, 02-2670-3914
④ Group Safety Insurance for Power-Device Users
Who: YDP residents using power wheelchairs/scooters (disabled or seniors 65+) / Coverage: 3rd-party injury/property damage from accidents while operating the device / Amount: up to KRW 50 million per accident (no deductible) / Enrollment: automatic, no application needed / Insurance inquiries: 02-2038-0828 Contact: Disability Welfare Div., Administration Team, 02-2670-1696
⑤ Birth Support Grant for Disabled-Parent Households
Who: Households where the newborn's father or mother is a registered person with a disability, continuously resident in YDP for 1 year before birth and registered with the child (if under 1 year, support starts after 1 year) / Amount: KRW 500,000 per newborn / Documents: applicant ID, bankbook copy / How: Visit your dong community center Contact: Disability Welfare Div., Support Team, 02-2670-4072
⑥ Childcare Support Grant for Disabled-Parent Households
Who: Disabled-parent households raising a child under 7 born on/after Jan 1, 2025 / Amount: KRW 100,000/month per child / Payment: the 20th of each month / How: Visit your dong community center Contact: Disability Welfare Div., Support Team, 02-2670-4072

Health

Home-Visit Care Co-pay Support
Who: YDP integrated-care registrants eligible for home-visit care / Support: 80% of the statutory co-pay for home-visit care (non-covered items excluded) / Amount: up to 20 visits/yr per person, capped at KRW 158,000/yr (varies by coverage type) / Payment: paid to the clinic after a visit from a designated institution / How: apply at your dong community center (prior inquiry required) Contact: Health Promotion Div., Care Health Team, 02-2670-4905
'Our Family's Healthy Table' (Diet Education)
Recruiting: until full (24 per cohort) / Who: residents in charge of household meals / Venue: 3F Yeongdeungpo-dong Community Hall (shared kitchen 'Cook Together') / Schedule: cohorts 3 & 4, 4 sessions each (theory+hands-on), Oct 23–Nov 13 / How: phone registration Contact: Community Health Div., Nutrition Plus Center, 02-2670-4845, 4848
Mental-Health Counseling Voucher Program
Apply: until budget runs out / Who: residents facing emotional difficulty / Program: 8 sessions of professional counseling / How: apply at your dong community center or online via Bokjiro / Documents: a referral from a mental-health welfare center, university counseling center, youth welfare center, etc., or a diagnosis/opinion letter from a mental-health institution (required) Contact: Health Promotion Div., Mind Health Team, 02-2670-4761
Free Dementia Screening
Hours: weekdays 09:00–18:00 (lunch 12:00–13:00) / Who: residents not yet diagnosed with dementia / Program: free Cognitive Impairment Screening Test (CIST, ~15 min) / How: call ahead then visit (bring ID) Contact: YDP Dementia Relief Center, 02-831-0855~6

영등포는 지금Yeongdeungpo Now · p.20

구민과 함께 만드는 새로운 영등포A New Yeongdeungpo, Built Together with Residents

구민의 목소리, 정책이 되다. 민주주의 축제 '민회'

민회란?
고대 그리스의 시민 집회인 '에클레시아'에서 유래된 말로, 영등포구 민회는 구정에 관심이 많은 구민 중 200명이 모여 지역 현안을 숙의하고 원탁토론과 투표를 통해 정책 방향을 논의하는 구민 대토론회입니다. 민회를 통해 선정된 정책제안은 관계부서 검토와 영등포구의회의 심의 등을 거쳐 정책 반영 여부를 결정합니다.
왜 필요한가요?
대한민국헌법 제1조제2항의 '대한민국의 주권은 국민에게 있고, 모든 권력은 국민으로부터 나온다'는 국민주권주의 원칙을 바탕으로, 구민이 구정의 주인으로서 직접 구정 현안을 살펴보고 함께 우리구에 필요한 사업을 논의하기 위해 '영등포구 민회'를 마련하였습니다.
어떻게 진행되나요?
토론 주제 공개 11.5.(목, 구 홈페이지 등 공개) → 사전토론회 11.20.(금) 14:00~16:00 → 민회 대토론회 12.3.(목) 14:00~16:00 ※ 구정 운영 상황에 따라 민회 토론 일정이 일부 조정되었음을 양해 부탁드립니다. 토론 운영시간은 현장 상황에 따라 조정될 수 있습니다.
「구민주권 영등포200」 모집

Residents' Voices Become Policy — the Democracy Festival 'Minhoe'

What is Minhoe?
From 'ecclesia,' the citizens' assembly of ancient Greece, YDP's Minhoe gathers 200 residents keen on district affairs to deliberate local issues and discuss policy direction through round-table debate and voting. Policy proposals chosen through Minhoe go through review by relevant departments and deliberation by the YDP Council before a decision is made on reflecting them in policy.
Why is it needed?
Based on the people's-sovereignty principle in Article 1(2) of the Constitution — 'The sovereignty of the Republic of Korea shall reside in the people, and all state authority shall emanate from the people' — 'YDP Minhoe' was created so that residents, as owners of district administration, can directly examine district issues and discuss needed projects together.
How does it proceed?
Topics announced Nov 5 (Thu, via district website etc.) → preliminary forum Nov 20 (Fri) 14:00–16:00 → Minhoe grand forum Dec 3 (Thu) 14:00–16:00 ※ The schedule may be adjusted depending on district administration needs, and session lengths may change on site.
'Resident Sovereignty YDP200' Recruitment
Apply: through Oct 20 (Tue, random drawing, winners notified individually by text around Oct 23) / Who: 200 people registered in YDP / Venue: preliminary forum — 5F gym, Yeongdeungpo-dong Community Center; Minhoe grand forum — to be announced / Content: the preliminary forum selects 5–6 lead topics from resident proposals via round-table debate; the Minhoe grand forum then selects 2–3 policy topics from those / Benefit: about KRW 20,000 expense reimbursement per session attended / How: apply via QR or visit your dong community center

A New Leap Forward — 'Cheonhajeil Yeongdeungpo'

Introducing the 9th popularly elected YDP administration's new civic slogan, 'Cheonhajeil Yeongdeungpo' (roughly, 'Yeongdeungpo, Best Under Heaven'). Together with residents, the district will build a city that leads Korea.

Meaning
The bold, rising straight lines represent a powerful leap forward; the long underline represents unceasing development; and the orange star symbolizes the bright future 'Cheonhajeil Yeongdeungpo' will unfold.
